# bioexcel/biobb_analysis/cpptraj_cluster

## Summary

Wrapper of the Ambertools Cpptraj module for clustering the frames of a given cpptraj compatible trajectory.

Cpptraj (the successor to ptraj) is the main program in Ambertools for processing coordinate trajectories and data files. The parameter names and defaults are the same as the ones in the official Cpptraj manual.

Nextflow adapter of the [CpptrajCluster](https://biobb-analysis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ambertools.html#module-ambertools.cpptraj_cluster) building block of [biobb_analysis](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_analysis) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_ANALYSIS_CPPTRAJ_CLUSTER } from 'bioexcel/biobb_analysis/cpptraj_cluster'

workflow {
    BIOBB_ANALYSIS_CPPTRAJ_CLUSTER(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_top_path` | yes | top, pdb, prmtop, parmtop, zip | Path to the input structure or topology file |
| `input_traj_path` | yes | mdcrd, crd, cdf, netcdf, nc, restart, ncrestart, restartnc, dcd, charmm, cor, pdb, mol2, trr, gro, binpos, xtc, cif, arc, sqm, sdf, conflib | Path to the input trajectory to be processed |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_cpptraj_path` | yes | dat, agr, xmgr, gnu | Path to the output cluster number vs time analysis |
| `output_summary_path` | no, opt-in | dat, agr, xmgr, gnu | Path to the output summary of the generated clusters |
| `output_info_path` | no, opt-in | dat, agr, xmgr, gnu | Path to the output detailed information of the generated clusters |
| `output_traj_path` | no, opt-in | mdcrd, crd, cdf, netcdf, nc, restart, ncrestart, restartnc, dcd, charmm, cor, pdb, mol2, trr, gro, binpos, xtc, cif, arc, sqm, sdf, conflib | Path to the output trajectory containing the representative frame of every cluster |
| `versions_biobb_analysis` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_analysis', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of CpptrajCluster properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_summary_path: 'dat']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_analysis container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_ANALYSIS_CPPTRAJ_CLUSTER' {
        ext.properties = [mask: 'c-alpha']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | integer | 1 | Starting frame for slicing |
| `end` | integer | -1 | Ending frame for slicing |
| `steps` | integer | 1 | Step for slicing |
| `mask` | string | "all-atoms" | Mask definition. Values: c-alpha, backbone, all-atoms, heavy-atoms, side-chain, solute, ions, solvent, AnyAmberFromatMask. |
| `algorithm` | string | "hieragglo" | Clustering algorithm. Values: hieragglo, dbscan, kmeans, dpeaks. |
| `clusters` | integer | 10 | Target number of clusters. Only used by the hieragglo and kmeans algorithms. |
| `epsilon` | number | -1.0 | Minimum distance between clusters. Mandatory for the dbscan and dpeaks algorithms; for hieragglo it is an additional stop condition, only used when greater than 0. |
| `minpoints` | integer | 4 | Minimum number of points required to form a cluster. Only used by the dbscan algorithm. |
| `linkage` | string | "linkage" | Distance between clusters. Only used by the hieragglo algorithm. Values: linkage, averagelinkage, complete. |
| `metric` | string | "rms" | Distance metric between frames. Values: rms, srmsd, dme, qrmsd. |
| `metric_mask` | string | "all-atoms" | Mask used for the distance metric calculation. Unlike **mask**, the atoms outside this selection are kept in the clustered coordinates, they are only left out of the frame to frame distance calculation. Values: c-alpha, backbone, all-atoms, heavy-atoms, side-chain, solute, ions, solvent, AnyAmberFromatMask. |
| `mass` | boolean | false | Mass-weight the distance metric. |
| `nofit` | boolean | false | Do not best-fit the frames before calculating the distance metric. |
| `sieve` | integer | 0 | Cluster only every nth frame and add the remaining frames back in afterwards. 0 disables sieving. |
| `binary_path` | string | "cpptraj" | Path to the cpptraj executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
